conclusion.original_create: permanently spent and held; no reset, retry, recreate, adoption or old-stage migration

findings.finding: Counts and pending intent are durably persisted before transport. provider_requests is the sum of these intents, so it cannot represent established provider requests.

Local preparation, deadline setup, adapter failures, interruptions and later validation errors are collapsed into generic Held and generic CLI JSON. No safe exception class or phase is durably retained.

Response-seen/status/time are not independently saved at header return. A projection failure is retried in the exception handler; another failure can erase even an observed HTTP500 status. create_received_at is captured after body/projection, not at response headers.

signal.signal deterministically raises ValueError when execute is invoked outside the main interpreter thread. This is a conditional local failure reproduced offline, not evidence the actual CLI ran that way.
Response close and alarm restoration exceptions can replace an earlier exception. Diagnostics should preserve the first failure and record only a secondary fixed cleanup category.

trust_env=False intentionally disables proxy environment use. A proxy-dependent executor could be affected; no such dependency or actual trial cause is established, and no environment/credential inspection was performed.

independent_offline_evidence.all_repros_preserved: create=1, PUT=0, GET=0, pending=create, failed=true, no identity, no response retained; dummy secret absent from persisted state
independent_offline_evidence.guard: Socket connect/connect_ex/create_connection/getaddrinfo forbidden; HTTPAdapter.send forbidden except explicit dummy adapter overrides; dummy temporary stages only.

parent_code_delta_review: Available for a later separately notified read-only review of the minimal future diagnostic diff.

read_only_reconciliation_plan.budget_accounting: Parent must issue the exact separate diagnostic read grant and retain historical193 plus every actual additional read; the modern8GET write-canary allowance is not replenished.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.candidate_detail: For an exact candidate, hardconstruct one GET /api/records/{id}/draft and revalidate full identity/metadata/files/PID shape within the same total budget. Never follow response links.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.candidate_identity: Exact namespace, fixed initial payload metadata canonical projection, known owner, canonical unique ID, aware created timestamp, unsubmitted/unpublished first draft and empty files; reject known old IDs. Preserve private IDs locally.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.endpoint_source_candidate: GET https://sandbox.zenodo.org/api/user/records with modern Accept; pinned framework route support is not verified deployed support.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.execution: Separate parent-dispatched provider executor only; no dispatch performed or grant issued by this review.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.limitation: The pinned inherited framework default_max_results is10000 and the parent-reported legacy scan failed at page101. A 200-page/240-GET client cap is numerically enough for16538 entries but cannot guarantee exhaustive deployed pagination. Any HTTP400, schema/order failure, duplicate ID, truncated/full final page or budget exhaustion leaves inventory incomplete. No global absence/snapshot claim.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.minimal_prefix_option: If modern route and explicit newest ordering are accepted and returned created values are validated as descending, inspect only through the lower creation-window boundary. This is recent candidate evidence only; index lag and mutable pagination prevent an absence/adoption conclusion.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.parameters: Explicit source-supported sort=newest (draft-search default is updated-desc), page and size only; no speculative namespace/title/created q, status filter, cursor, response-link following or redirect. Source supports allversions explicitly if parent needs prior versions; do not infer a deployed parameter contract.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.time_evidence: Use the sanitized intent timestamp and terminal observation as bounded search context, allowing only explicitly recorded clock tolerance; terminal completion is not a response or exact failure-capture timestamp.
read_only_reconciliation_plan.zero_one_multiple_outcome: Evidence only. Zero matches may reflect indexing/route/scan incompleteness; one or multiple matches cannot reset create, bind ledger, adopt ID, PUT or publish. Original uncertain create remains held.

recommended_minimal_future_diagnostics.exception_mapping: Map known exception types to fixed category literals, including dedicated deadline/interruption and other categories; never persist arbitrary class/module names, exception args, chained string representations or stack traces.
focused_test_recommendations: Local JSON/header preparation error before adapter entry
Mocked adapter ConnectionError/Timeout and signal deadline categories
Observed HTTP500 followed by projection failure retains status
Partial body read timeout retains bounded evidence
Secrets embedded in exception args/custom class names never persist
Failed old state rejects runtime change without any request
recommended_minimal_future_diagnostics.header_evidence: Save response_seen, validated status and capture time independently before body/projection. Preserve first safe failure projection before generic wrapping; projection and cleanup failures must not erase it.
recommended_minimal_future_diagnostics.invariants: Pre-send durable action budget remains spent, retries and redirects remain disabled, original stages remain held and immutable. Future diagnostics do not authorize a new create.
recommended_minimal_future_diagnostics.redaction: No str(exc), request headers, token, raw URL, request/response body, arbitrary response header or link in transport exception diagnostics. Existing HTTP body projection remains separate.
safe_fields: validated integer HTTP status when observed
observed body size and SHA when available
recommended_minimal_future_diagnostics.transport_boundary: Explicit Requests Request construction and Session.prepare_request, followed by Session.send with an actual HTTPAdapter entry hook. adapter_entered records local adapter entry only; it does not prove socket bytes reached Zenodo.

scope: Independent static review and mocked offline reproductions only; no repository edits, provider requests, credentials, private provider stages or terminal audits read.
trial_facts_source: Sanitized parent report only, not independently verified from private run files.
